name: Circadian and PPARA/PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of metabolism
rationale: Members are transcriptional regulators linking clock (BMAL1:CLOCK, ROR/REV-ERB, heme, NPAS) and PPARA/PGC-1alpha mitochondrial-lipid programmes; unlike the core-clock confusable it has PPAR/PGC-1alpha, and unlike the gluconeogenic/LXR/adipogenic ones it has circadian activators.

name: eNOS-derived nitric oxide synthesis and NO-cGMP signaling
rationale: All members concern NO production by NOS and its cGMP signalling, whereas confusables cover downstream smooth muscle/blood pressure physiology, eNOS trafficking or renal guanylyl cyclase signalling.

qualifier: 5'/3'-end processing and intron splicing in nucleus and mitochondria
name: Nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA end processing and splicing
rationale: Members are tRNA maturation steps (leader removal, 3'-end processing, intron cleavage, mitochondrial tRNA processing/modification, tRF biogenesis), distinct from confusables centred on pseudouridylation, tRNA import or aminoacylation.

qualifier: aldosterone regulation and CYP enzyme defects
name: Adrenal gluco- and mineralocorticoid biosynthesis, aldosterone regulation, CYP defects
rationale: Members cover cortisol/aldosterone synthesis, its regulation and secretion, and CYP11/17/21 deficiency disorders, lacking the sex-steroid, pregnenolone or aldosterone-response content of confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: ERBB-family and MET receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are EGFR/ERBB2-4 and MET/HGF receptor signalling events via SHC/GRB2/PI3K/PLCG1 to AKT and ERK, distinguishing it from PTK6-, IGF1R- and MET-only confusables.

qualifier: axon fasciculation, synapse pruning and neuron remodeling
name: Eph-ephrin repulsion in axon fasciculation and neuron remodeling
rationale: Members are ephrin receptor signalling and its repulsive neuronal outcomes, unlike semaphorin, netrin/DCC, L1 or SLIT/ROBO guidance confusables.

name: E2F-regulated cell cycle and DNA replication initiation
rationale: Members are E2F target/cell cycle modules plus replication initiation and unwinding, whereas confusables emphasise G1/S transcription repression, pre-RC assembly or break-induced replication.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and regulation
rationale: Members concern Pol II initiation, preinitiation complex assembly and transcription-factor/chromatin regulator modules, distinct from confusables focused on elongation, pausing and termination.

qualifier: inner/middle ear morphogenesis and sensory hair cell fate
name: Inner and middle ear morphogenesis and hair cell fate
rationale: Members build the otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canals, middle ear and auditory nerve and specify hair cells, unlike confusables covering outer ear, eye, nose or cranial nerves.

qualifier: alpha-2 inhibition of catecholamine and insulin secretion
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of catecholamine and insulin secretion
rationale: Members are epinephrine/adrenoceptor responses centred on alpha-2 feedback limiting catecholamine and insulin release, versus cardiac beta-adrenergic or generic Gi/cAMP-inhibition confusables.

qualifier: definitive endoderm and early pancreatic progenitors
name: Definitive endoderm specification and early pancreatic progenitor lineages
rationale: Members run from pluripotency exit and definitive endoderm/foregut to multipotent, ductal and endocrine-progenitor pancreatic lineages, lacking the gastrulation or late endocrine content of confusables.

qualifier: adiponectin signaling and insulin receptor attenuation
name: Regulation of insulin sensitivity, glucose import and adiponectin signaling
rationale: Members regulate insulin receptor/IRS signalling, glucose import, glycogen synthesis and adiponectin, unlike glucagon/gluconeogenesis, GLUT4-trafficking or AKT2/IGF1R confusables.

qualifier: latency and host restriction of viral transcription
name: Cytomegalovirus infection cycle, latency and host antiviral restriction
rationale: Members are HCMV early/late events, viral latency and host sensing/suppression of viral transcription, distinct from the HIV/retroviral confusables.

qualifier: cytosolic/nuclear rRNA, tRNA and snRNA via snoRNPs
name: Pseudouridylation and methylation of nuclear rRNA, tRNA and snRNA
rationale: Members are base modifications of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and mRNA with snoRNP assembly, unlike mitochondrial RNA, tRNA aminoacylation, Cajal body or rRNA cleavage/decay confusables.

name: Gastrointestinal motility and endothelin-dependent enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members cover gut smooth muscle contraction, peristalsis, stomach/midgut development and endothelin-driven neural crest colonisation of the enteric nervous system, versus RET/GDNF, vascular or urinary confusables.

name: Centrosome positioning and MTOC microtubule nucleation and anchoring
rationale: Members locate and hold the centrosome and nucleate/anchor microtubules at it with cortical protein targeting, unlike mitotic centrosome maturation, centriole/cilium, tubulin modification or spindle orientation confusables.

qualifier: control by competing endogenous and long noncoding RNAs
name: PTEN restraint of PI3K/AKT, regulated by competing endogenous RNAs
rationale: Members concern PTEN-mediated negative regulation of PI3K/AKT and IGF1R signalling and its ceRNA/lncRNA control, distinct from inositol phosphate, RNA-binding protein or PTEN stability confusables.

name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuronal patterning and differentiation
rationale: Members pattern the dorsoventral neural tube and generate spinal motor/interneurons, brainstem and branchiomotor neurons, unlike midbrain, cranial-sensory, neural plate or enteric confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: MET/HGF and ALK-family receptor signaling to PI3K/AKT
rationale: Members are MET/HGF receptor activation and effectors plus ALK/LTK and PI3K/AKT/ERK activation, lacking the ERBB, PTK6 and IGF1R content of confusables.

qualifier: strand invasion and repair DNA synthesis
name: Recombinational DNA repair by strand invasion and repair synthesis
rationale: Members are homologous recombination-type repair routes (SDSA, BIR, sister chromatid exchange, crosslink repair) with strand invasion and repair synthesis, versus NHEJ/DSB-sensing or checkpoint confusables.

name: MHC class II peptide loading and antigen presentation
rationale: All members concern processing and loading of exogenous peptides onto MHC class II, unlike MHC class I cross-presentation, lipid antigen or regulatory confusables.

name: IL-12/IL-23 and IL-17 signaling in the Th17 axis
rationale: Members are IL-12/IL-23 signalling, IL-17 production/signalling and Th17 commitment, distinct from IL-10/IL-27, IL-33/36 or Dectin antifungal confusables.

core: Vascular smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction-relaxation in arterial pressure control
rationale: Members regulate smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and vasoconstriction underlying endothelin- and catecholamine-driven arterial pressure, versus pulmonary/hypotensive, adrenergic receptor or NO/guanylyl cyclase confusables.

qualifier: immunoglobulin gene diversification in B cells
name: Mismatch repair and B cell immunoglobulin gene diversification
rationale: Members are MMR and its defects plus somatic hypermutation, class switching, V(D)J recombination and B cell commitment, unlike T cell proliferation, TGF-beta cancer mutant, base excision or APOBEC confusables.

name: Insulin and adiponectin signaling to glucose uptake and glycogen
rationale: Members span insulin receptor/IRS/AKT2 signalling, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import, glycogen synthesis and adiponectin, unlike glucagon/ChREBP/gluconeogenesis or RHOQ confusables.
